newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says investment forecasts on track.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says investment forecasts on track.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that forecasts for business investment were looking "pretty good".
"We think the business investment forecasts are looking pretty good," Costello told reporters.
"It was a strong investment forecast -- 14 percent. And the evidence to date is that we'll meet it," he said.
"I don't think that this particular rate (cut) will change the outlook in relation to that."
Earlier, the Reserve Bank of Australia effected its second monetary easing for the year, dropping its overnight cash rate target to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.
The government forecast 14 percent year-average business investment growth in its August budget.
Economists had been expressed concern about the outlook for business investment because of recent economic data, particularly weakness for capital imports.
